rationale: Adds full native Dreame map-path collection and persistence beyond sampled positions, with reset/run proof and diagnostics. Geometry fidelity fixes are coupled to this new core capability, not misclassified as a stable patch.

summary.ru: Полные маршруты поддерживаемых карт пылесоса и сохранение поворотов без слепого прореживания; диагностика качества пути.
summary.en: Full paths from supported vacuum maps, retained turns without blind thinning, and path-quality diagnostics.
